newsitem.title: PERU: Newmont lists on Lima bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Newmont lists on Lima bolsa.

text.p: Newmont Mining Corp, which operates South America's largest gold mine, Yanacocha, had its shares officially listed on the Lima Stock Exchange Friday, bolsa officials and brokers said.
The stock is due to start trading Wednesday.
The market will set Newmont's opening price depending on the informal purchase offers brokers receive before Wednesday.
"There is expectation for the new mining share, but some traders are skeptical about the frequency with which it will trade," one broker said.
Market officials have said Newmont has registered 99.3 million shares on the Lima market with a nominal value of $1.60 each.
Newmont had announced its intention last year to list shares on the local market, saying it was justified by the firm's large presence in Peru through Yanacocha.
Newmont has a 51.35 percent stake in Yanacocha, a joint venture with local firm Cia. Minera Buenaventura SA, which has a 43.65 percent stake.
It will be the third company to trade simultaneously in New York and Lima after Holding Credicorp and Southern Peru Copper Corp.
Newmont's shares on the Lima exchange will carry the symbol NEM.LM on Reuters terminals.
